result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A covers everything the brief asked for. B has a strong sign-off process with highlighted lines but no way to tell when a page is out of date or should be retired. B also includes an invented example product name and weight, though it is marked as an example. Both are somewhat over 800 words, and both handle the lack of analytics well. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B covers each brief more completely, with an explicit job, reader, sources table and a 'goes stale when' trigger that names who watches for changes. A has no way to tell when a page is out of date or should be retired. Both stick to the supplied facts and handle the missing analytics well, but B leaves visible placeholders for unknowns such as Ines's review turnaround, while A uses an invented example product title.
